headline: Coalition says it intercepted TEN ballistic missiles fired toward southern Saudi Arabia, plus a cruise missile toward Khamis
dek: The Saudi-led coalition said two drones and a ballistic missile were launched toward Riyadh and a cruise missile toward the southern city of Khamis Mushait on Sunday, and later said it intercepted ten ballistic missiles fired toward southern Saudi Arabia. Saudi civil defence issued emergency…
sources: Reuters, via GMA News Online / Haaretz / Oman Observer / Jerusalem Post carries; Times of Israel liveblog (own entry, Lazar Berman) for the Khamis Mushait cruise-missile intercept
fault_line: Airport reopened under fire vs airport as legitimate military target: does a partial reopening plus a 10-missile intercept day signal control, or exposure?

sections.what_happened: The Saudi-led coalition said two drones and a ballistic missile were launched toward Riyadh and a cruise missile toward the southern city of Khamis Mushait on Sunday, and later said it intercepted ten ballistic missiles fired toward southern Saudi Arabia. Saudi civil defence issued emergency alerts for Riyadh, Abha and Khamis Mushait, then announced minutes later that the danger had passed. Ansar Allah military spokesman Yahya Saree said the airport remained a 'military target' and warned all airlines, airport staff and travellers against using Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport, which resumed operations at Terminals 1 (domestic) and 2 (international, national carriers) on Sunday after the deadly Oct 10 attack. The Ansar Allah said they attacked the airport and Saudi oil facilities on Saturday; Saudi authorities did not comment directly on the Ansar Allah statements. This 10-missile southern salvo is NEW to scans: 1600-02 recorded only the overnight Riyadh intercepts (2 drones + 1 ballistic missile) and Saturday's 7-attack salvo.
sections.what_verified: 2 distinct publisher families: Reuters T1 (coalition claims, alerts, Saree warning, airport reopening) + Times of Israel T3 (own liveblog entry confirming the Khamis Mushait cruise-missile intercept and the earlier Riyadh missile). GMA/Haaretz/Oman Observer/JPost are Reuters carries and add no family.
sections.what_disputed: Intercepts are coalition claims carried by Reuters, not independently verified damage/intercept evidence. Ansar Allah claims of Saturday airport/oil-facility attacks are unconfirmed by Saudi authorities. Prior-scan counterweight stands: Ansar Allah deny targeting Mecca/Medina; Sanaa health ministry claims of Saudi-strike civilian deaths remain unconfirmed by the coalition.
sections.why_matters: Ten ballistic missiles at the south, alerts over three cities, and the airport reopening anyway: Sunday was the biggest Saudi intercept day yet in this front, and the Ansar Allah just re-declared the airport a target.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP to totw-20261025-1600-02 (Saudi/Ansar Allah front) -- Reuters Sunday: coalition says it intercepted TEN ballistic missiles fired toward southern Saudi Arabia, plus a cruise missile toward Khamis Mushait; civil-defence alerts for Riyadh, Abha, Khamis Mushait

totw_analysis: Our read: Ten ballistic missiles at the south, alerts over three cities, and the airport reopening anyway: Sunday was the biggest Saudi intercept day yet in this front, and the Ansar Allah just re-declared the airport a target. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Airport reopened under fire vs airport as legitimate military target: does a partial reopening plus a 10-missile intercept day signal control, or exposure?
